# Language servers

The language servers Pomelo can start, the languages each one serves and the
folder it runs in. Under each are the programs that can be it, in the order
they are tried; the first one found runs. The `language_servers` setting
names them to reorder them, turn one off with `!name`, or turn on an opt-in
one, which runs only when named there (see
[Language servers](/docs/app#language-servers)).

Pomelo looks for each program on your login shell's `PATH` first. Servers
published to npm are downloaded when missing (with your `node` and `npm`)
into `~/Library/Application Support/Pomelo/languages`.

## rust-analyzer

For Rust. Runs in the folder of the outermost `Cargo.toml`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `rust-analyzer` | `rust-analyzer` | - | Install it: `rustup component add rust-analyzer` |

## typescript

For TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript. Runs in the folder of the outermost `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` or `jsconfig.json`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `vtsls` | `vtsls --stdio` | - | Downloaded from npm (`@vtsls/language-server`) |
| `typescript-language-server` | `typescript-language-server --stdio` | - | Install it yourself |

## tailwindcss

For TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, CSS, HTML, PHP, Svelte. Runs in the folder of the outermost `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` or `jsconfig.json`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tailwindcss-language-server` | `tailwindcss-language-server --stdio` | - | Downloaded from npm (`@tailwindcss/language-server`) |

## eslint

For TypeScript, TSX, JavaScript, Svelte. Runs in the folder of the outermost `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` or `jsconfig.json`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eslint` | `node vscode-eslint/server/out/eslintServer.js --stdio` | - | Built once from its source release |

## gopls

For Go. Runs in the folder of the outermost `go.work` or `go.mod`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `gopls` | `gopls` | - | Install it: `go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@latest` |

## python

For Python. Runs in the folder of the nearest `pyproject.toml`, `setup.py`, `setup.cfg`, `requirements.txt` or `pyrightconfig.json`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `basedpyright` | `basedpyright-langserver --stdio` | - | Downloaded from npm (`basedpyright`) |
| `pyright` | `pyright-langserver --stdio` | - | Downloaded from npm (`pyright`) |
| `ty` | `ty server` | - | Install it: `uv tool install ty` |

## clangd

For C, C++. Runs in the folder of the nearest `compile_commands.json`, `CMakeLists.txt` or `.clangd`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `clangd` | `clangd` | - | Install it yourself |

## ruby

For Ruby. Runs in the folder of the nearest `Gemfile`, else the workspace folder.

| Name | Program | Opt-in | When missing |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `solargraph` | `solargraph stdio` | - | Install it: `gem install solargraph` |
| `ruby-lsp` | `ruby-lsp` | yes | Install it: `gem install ruby-lsp` |
